title: phlox glaberrima subsp. interior
intro: Phlox glaberrima subsp. interior, commonly known as the interior phlox or wild blue phlox, is a perennial plant in the family Polemoniaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Native American cultures, for its medicinal properties. The plant is said to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe various health conditions, including wounds and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Phlox glaberrima subsp. interior include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic effects.
